name: Wander Wombat
description: Wander Wombat is a palm-sized explorer with a squishable belly and a felt backpack stuffed with snack crumbs and tiny maps. It loves aisle-seat optimism, dramatic passport stamps, and sending postcard doodles from pocket level. Book this fuzzball a trip and expect cheerful trip reports, souvenir sticker swaps, and heroic naps in cup holders.

name: Socktopus
description: Socktopus is an eight-armed cutie sewn from mismatched travel socks, with buttony suckers and a permanent “I can hold your snacks” grin. It clings to windows, tray tables, and hearts, collecting tiny baggage tags and stamping a miniature passport with every wiggle. Book this clingy companion for chaos-free layovers, emergency giggles, and heroic cup-holder hugs.
